第23章先赚灵石
无数五彩的光点围绕在她的身边，金、青、蓝、红、黄，他们代表着灵气中的五行。
李婉自然而然的开始运转心法，尝试捕捉和引导游离在空气中的灵气进入到体内。
指尖处传来一丝极弱的清凉感，如春日，万物复苏时，山间解冻的第一缕清泉。
李婉看见，蓝色的光点绕着手指漂浮了几圈后，好似终于下定了某种决心似的，没入了她的指尖。
蓝色，水灵根。
李婉继续努力，越来越多水灵气被纳入身体，其他的灵气则对她毫无兴趣，依旧漫无目的的在空气中漂浮。
所以，她是单一水灵根么？
一阵狂喜从心头涌起。
在修真界待了三个月，虽然如何修炼她一知半解，但是一些修真界的常识她还是知道的。
一般来说，灵根越少就代表着修炼速度越快，资质越高。
而资质高的人，向来是大宗门争相抢夺的好苗子。
凭着单灵根资质，或许她去到香炉宗可以直接当弟子了，也许可以不从杂役做起了。
这可真是可喜可贺！
李婉完全沉浸在了修炼中，等再次醒来时，时间已经过去三日了。
惊奇的是她三天没吃饭、没喝水，身体竟然还是活力满满的样子，甚至比之前感觉更加轻快有劲，好像身体里的每一寸血肉经脉被洗涤过一般。
她抬手，运转功法，指尖萦绕着一层淡淡的蓝色灵光。
这就是引气入体了。
峰回又路转，她终于能修炼了！
李婉快乐得直冒泡泡，忍不住放声大笑起来。

笑完后，她跑出门去，买了几刀纸，开始给老家写信，在外头比在流林宗自由。
再也不用担心自己写的信被人看见了，李婉打算以后身上常备纸笔，想到啥就写啥。
不然等寄东西前一起写，总觉得会落下很多东西，某些心得体会，也会随着时间的推移而变得模糊不清。
买好纸后，李婉先将自己引起入体的经验写下，又表达了她的喜悦之情，写了半页的引气入体心得体会后，她终于停了笔。
等情绪释放完毕后，她又发了愁。
修炼并非一腔孤勇就能行的，想要往上爬，必须得有资源。
引气入体只是修炼的开端，往后的每一步都需要海量的资源堆砌。
丹药、法器、符箓、功法、天材地宝……哪一样不需要灵石？
她现在想要给自己买几个法术来傍身，都舍不得花灵石。
那日去买心法时她问过，店里最便宜的一个火球术都得五十灵石。
等想法挣点灵石才可以。
李婉锁门外出，镇上有一条街是专门做修真者生意的，她或许去那处能启发一下赚钱的灵感。
李婉很快到了地方。
这条街很安静，不论是买东西还是卖东西的都是，卖家席地而坐，将商品摆在地上后。
然后，就在后头打坐修炼，很冷淡，不像刚刚路过的凡人街市那般大声叫卖，而买家们安静的穿行于各个摊位前，如有感兴趣的就会驻足询问。
李婉看见摊子上有卖野生灵草的，卖丹药的，卖法器的，卖从不知名秘境找到的功法的，还有直接卖妖兽肉妖兽丹的，商品种类繁杂，看得人眼花缭乱。

Chapter 23 Earn spiritual stones first
Countless colorful light spots surrounded her, gold, green, blue, red, and yellow, they represented the five elements in aura.
Li Wan naturally started to use his mental skills, trying to capture and guide the spiritual energy floating in the air into his body.
There was a faint feeling of coolness at the fingertips, like the first ray of clear spring thawing in the mountains when everything comes to life in spring.
Li Wan saw blue light spots floating around her fingers for a few times, then seemed to have finally made up her mind and disappeared into her fingertips.
Blue, water spirit root.
Li Wan continued to work hard, and more and more water auras were incorporated into her body. Other auras had no interest in her and were still floating in the air aimlessly.
So, is she a single water spirit root?
A burst of ecstasy surged through my heart.
After staying in the world of cultivation for three months, although she knew little about how to practice, she still knew some common sense about the world of cultivation.
Generally speaking, the fewer spiritual roots, the faster the cultivation speed and the higher the qualifications.
People with high qualifications have always been good candidates that many sects compete for.
With her single spirit root qualification, maybe she can become a disciple directly when she goes to the Xianglu Sect, or maybe she can stop working as a handyman.
This is really gratifying!
Li Wan was completely immersed in practice. When she woke up again, three days had passed.
What was surprising was that despite not eating or drinking for three days, her body was still full of energy. She even felt lighter and more energetic than before, as if every inch of flesh and blood in her body had been washed.
She raised her hand and started running the technique, and a faint blue aura lingered on her fingertips.
This is the introduction of Qi into the body.
Things took a turn for the worse, and she was finally able to practice!
Li Wan was so happy that she burst out laughing.
After laughing, she ran out, bought some paper, and started writing letters to her hometown. She felt more free outside than in Liulin Sect.
She no longer has to worry about the letters she writes being seen by others. Li Wan plans to always have pen and paper with her in the future and write whatever comes to mind.
Otherwise, if you wait to write them all before sending them, you will always feel that a lot of things will be left behind, and some of your experiences will become blurry as time goes by.
After buying the paper, Li Wan first wrote down her experience of introducing Qi into the body, and then expressed her joy. After writing half a page about her experience of introducing Qi into the body, she finally stopped writing.
After she finished releasing her emotions, she became worried again.
Cultivation is not something you can do alone. If you want to climb up, you must have resources.
Introducing Qi into the body is only the beginning of cultivation, and every step thereafter requires a massive accumulation of resources.
Medicinal pills, magic weapons, talismans, exercises, heavenly materials and earthly treasures... Which of them do not require spiritual stones?
She now wants to buy herself some spells to keep with her, but she is reluctant to spend the spirit stones.
She asked when she went to buy a mental spell that day. The cheapest fireball spell in the store cost fifty spiritual stones.
Just wait until you think about earning some spiritual stones.
Li Wan locked the door and went out. There was a street in the town dedicated to cultivators' business. Maybe she could get inspiration for making money by going there.
Li Wan arrived at the place quickly.
This street is very quiet, no matter whether you are buying or selling things, the sellers are sitting on the ground and placing their goods on the ground.
Then, he meditated in the back, very coldly, unlike the ordinary people who just passed by the street market who shouted loudly. The buyers walked quietly in front of each stall, and stopped to ask if they were interested.
Li Wan saw that there were stalls selling wild spiritual herbs, elixirs, magic weapons, exercises found in unknown secret realms, and some directly selling monster meat and monster elixirs. The variety of products was so diverse that it was dazzling.
